name: quintinbotes
description: Claude Code plugins by Quintin Botes: code review, debugging discipline, agent orchestration, autonomous engineering loops, governed codebase simplification, and a guard against leaking private terms when publishing.

plugins.name: review-voice
plugins.description: A concise, precedent-aware code reviewer that calibrates to your review judgment. Every finding names a concrete failure mode in 40 words or fewer, ordered worst-first, evidence required, silence when nothing qualifies.

plugins.name: circuit-breaker
plugins.description: Investigation, mutation, refutation and verification as states a hook enforces, rather than instructions a model is asked to follow.

plugins.name: orbit
plugins.description: An autonomous, evidence-driven engineering loop for Claude Code: contracts, isolated workers, independent verification, and recoverable unattended runs.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Parallel agent orchestrator: author a spec, decompose it into exclusive-ownership tasks, execute them across isolated git worktrees, and gate the merge on QA and review.

plugins.name: unknot
plugins.description: Architecture-aware, incremental codebase simplification. Maps the code, data and infrastructure into a graph with provenance, finds accidental complexity, chooses decomposition patterns from measured evidence, and changes code only in small approved slices that a deterministic kernel verifies and can roll back.

plugins.name: publish-guard
plugins.description: Blocks commits, pushes, pull requests, issues, releases and GitHub API calls that would put private terms or a non-allowed email into repositories of protected GitHub owners. One scanner runs as a Claude Code hook, as git hooks and in CI.
